title: Scientists discover the “Goldilocks” secret behind life on Earth

title: Scientists find quantum computers forget most of their work

title: Scientists trap light in a layer 1,000x thinner than hair

title: AI breakthrough cuts energy use by 100x while boosting accuracy

title: Scientists may finally detect hidden ripples in spacetime

The breakthrough means powerful tools like LIGO and even small tabletop experiments could start testing competing theories of quantum gravity much sooner than expected.

title: Mars dust storms are sparking electricity and rewriting the planet’s chemistry
summary: Mars may look like a quiet, dusty world, but it’s actually buzzing with hidden electrical activity. Powerful dust storms and swirling dust devils generate static electricity strong enough to spark faint glowing discharges across the planet, triggering chemical reactions that reshape its surface and atmosphere. title: Truckloads of food are being wasted because computers won’t approve them

title: Scientists just uncovered the secret behind nature’s “proton highway”
summary: Scientists have zoomed in on how phosphoric acid moves electrical charges so efficiently in both biology and technology. This structure relies on a specific hydrogen-bond network that may be universal in similar systems. The discovery helps explain how protons travel so quickly and could inspire better energy materials.

title: Did a black hole just explode? This “impossible” particle may be the evidence

This could explain why only one experiment saw the event. The theory also opens the door to discovering entirely new particles and possibly uncovering the nature of dark matter.

title: This walking robot could change how we search for life on Mars
